comparison.objective: Raise a pump baseplate 15 mm on two wedges to align its outlet with a pipe without excessive tilt.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized bimanual wedge driving and load leveling under squeeze-back.
comparison.success_condition: Both feet seated 15 mm higher with baseplate tilt never exceeding 2 degrees; finer force and alignment tolerances are not supplied.
comparison.reason: Both involve iterative physical response, but this record tests synchronized translational leveling of a heavy base. It has no fine tool/socket access, locking sequence, tuned damping, or repeated impact-stop criterion.
